sources.snippet: Home Examples AutoRound Quantization llm-compressor supports AutoRound, an advanced quantization technique that delivers high-accuracy, low-bit quantization. The quantized results are fully compatible with compressed-tensors and can be served directly with vLLM. AutoRound introduces three trainable parameters (V, α, and β) to optimize rounding values and clipping ranges during quantization ...
